verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community comment confirming that Mixpanel offers group-level/account-level analytics for B2B SaaS. The same comment notes it is gated behind higher-priced plans. No first-party docs in the pack describe how account-level funnels or retention work. missing for 10: first-party documentation of group/account analytics, evidence it applies across funnels and retention reports, availability on lower plans, hands-on corroboration.
